anomalies.observed: Both U2 (ATtiny45-20P) and U3 (ATtiny13V-10S) are connected to the same signal nets (SDA, PWM, SCK, POT, TACH, RST).
anomalies.expected: Only one microcontroller should be populated; the design should either have a single MCU or a means to select between them without bus contention.
